correctness.rationale: Stationarity of \(y^2/2\), an antiderivative of \(f\), \(yz\), \(x^2/2\), \(xy\) and \(xz\) gives \(\mathbb E[z^2]=\mathbb E[y^2]\) and \(\mathbb E[x f(x)]=-\beta\mathbb E[y^2]\). Zero energy forces invariant support onto equilibria. On a nonconstant periodic orbit, \(y=x'\) has zero mean and \(z=y'\); Wirtinger's inequality plus the exact energy equality yields \(P\ge2\pi\). Equality forces a first harmonic and substitution gives the exact affine restoring law on the swept interval; the converse is immediate. In the 1981 piecewise model, \(x f(x)<0\) exactly outside the outer equilibrium radius, which forces the stated excursions, while the equality interval can lie in an outer branch exactly when \(\beta=\mu\) with the stated amplitudes. The exact verifier independently checks the generator identities and piecewise algebra.
